article.hook: Someone’s still holding onto a secret they stopped needing years ago. The South Node in Scorpio shows us what’s been dragging beneath the surface, waiting for release.
article.lived: For about eighteen months, we notice the same old power plays replaying in meetings, friendships, or family dinners. Patterns of control and shadowed history bubble up - maybe a long-avoided conversation or a hidden resentment. The pressure is real enough that we can’t ignore what’s tangled beneath our daily routines, forcing us to sift through emotional junk we thought was buried.
article.turn: The problem starts when we keep spinning the same stories, replaying grudges and betrayals as if they protect us. This grip on past wounds stops new trust from forming. Let go of the old ghosts by naming them aloud or cutting ties that no longer serve you. Holding on only feeds the chain it claims to break.
moves: Speak one truth you’ve been hiding in a safe space this week.
Refuse to replay a power struggle that’s gone nowhere before.
Clear one digital or physical archive that holds old grudges or secrets.
